description: This file defines a SQLiteRecordManager class implementing record management functionalities such as schema creation, key listing, existence checks, updates, and deletions, specifically for SQLite databases. It also includes an initialization class for setting up the manager with configuration options.

classes.name: SQLiteRecordManager_RecordManager
classes.description: Implements the INode interface, responsible for initializing and configuring the SQLite record manager.

classes.name: SQLiteRecordManager
classes.description: Main class implementing RecordManagerInterface, providing methods for schema creation, key management, and data operations in SQLite.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the record manager with configuration options, setting up database path, connection, and other parameters.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates the necessary SQLite table and indexes if they do not exist.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current timestamp from the SQLite database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Upserts records with specified keys and optional group IDs, updating timestamps.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks existence of given keys in the database.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists keys with optional filters such as time bounds, group IDs, and document ID.

methods.name: deleteKeys
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the database.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates table names to prevent SQL injection and ensure proper format.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Creates and initializes a TypeORM DataSource for database operations.
